layers.layer: Software user interface and sample shown on screen
layers.evidence: About capture: 'Copyright (c) 1987-1991 Microsoft Corp.' The Calculator form and CALC.FRM code appear to be a program open in the IDE; that it is a Microsoft-supplied sample is NOT verified.
layers.terms_found: Microsoft 'Use of Microsoft copyrighted content' (https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/legal/intellectualproperty/copyright/permissions, accessed 2026-09-15, saved as evidence/source-pages/microsoft-copyright-permissions.html). Screenshots of released products may be used 'in videos' if the user does not alter the screenshot except to resize it, does not use portions, does not include third-party content or an identifiable individual, and meets the page's general requirements, including the statement 'Used with permission from Microsoft'. Splash screens and beta or unreleased products are excluded.
layers.fit_with_this_asset: Visual Basic 1.0 was commercially released; the Edit capture is not a splash screen and shows no person. The editorial frame resizes the whole screenshot without cropping, overlays or edits (src/frame.json). Open: whether Microsoft's guidelines apply to a screenshot captured by someone else, whether pillarboxing counts as alteration, whether the CALC sample or desktop icons count as third-party content, and whether the video's use fits.
layers.status: unresolved - legal judgement, not settled by evidence
